maya: handing off primary to @ryan — quick recap before I jump: we had a P2-page for embeddings p99 surge in ap-southeast at ~06:08 UTC. Root cause suspected: cronwarm job failed on node reboot + an aggressive scale-to-zero rule. I applied an emergency mitigation (pinned replicas + forced warmup).

ryan: ack, taking primary. can you dump the short mitigation log and any commands you ran?

maya: pasted the steps i did. full details in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-high-latency
```
- check alerts: `alerts query "service:embeddings AND p99 > 500ms" --since 10m`
- inspect cronjob: `kubectl -n ops get cronjob cache-warmup -o yaml`
- check nodes: `kubectl get nodes --show-labels`
- temporarily set min replicas: `kubectl -n models scale deploy embeddings --replicas=3`
- trigger cache warmup: `/ops/crontriggers/warmup-runner --region ap-southeast`
- rollback if model change suspected: `deploy-bot rollback embeddings-model --to stable-202602`
```

incident-bot: INCIDENT #2050 - embeddings-high-p99 triggered at 2062232880. Severity: P2. Pager routed to oncall rotation and maya.

paging-bot: Pager escalated to ryan at 2062233005 (primary). Secondary ping to priya.

nate: note — the kubelet reboot on node-az3 caused our warmup cron job pod to land on a tainted node. I'll follow up with infra to make the job node-affine and tolerant of reboots.

alex: i'm going to open RED-OPS-500 to track HPA cooldown + scale floor changes. Proposed: increase stabilizationWindowSeconds to 120 and set minReplicas to 2 during business hours.

ryan: just ran the warmup trigger in ap-southeast; p99 dropped 840ms -> 260ms over 6m. i'll keep tailing logs and the metrics dashboard.

priya: i'm on secondary and watching customer channels. no inbound complaints yet but we'll prepare a short blurb if needed. product comms lead is @sana if we need to notify customers.

maya: small note — i also disabled the autoscaler thrash rule that aggressively scaled to zero when qps < 1 for under 30s. That was causing oscillations when warmup was slow.

deploy-bot: deployment note: temporary replica change applied to `embeddings` by maya at 2062233100. Reversion scheduled +30m.

ryan: action list I'm tracking:
- monitor embeddings p50/p95/p99 and alert channel for 2h (primary) — ryan
- validate warmup cronjob node affinity + tolerations — nate
- open infra ticket for HPA tuning & scale floor — alex (RED-OPS-500)
- draft postmortem and timeline — maya + nate (RED-INC-2050)
- customer comms readiness — priya

maya: i've filed the incident ticket RED-INC-2050 with initial timeline and logs attached. assigning postmortem ownership to nate. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-INC-2050

nate: taking postmortem owner. i'll collect traces and reproduce steps today, retro invite will go out for tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

priya: suggestion for runbook: add a quick checklist for forced warmup and a one-liner to check cronjob last-run timestamp. I'll make a small PR.

alex: i've added a temp alert rule to suppress scale-to-zero notifications during warmup maintenance windows — we should discuss long term change in retro.

incident-bot: INCIDENT #2050 - status changed to monitoring at 2062233600.

ryan: APAC metrics stable for now, p99 holding ~230ms. no new paging events. i'll remain on-watch for the next 60m then handback if clean.

maya: i'm passing secondary to @priya for the next 3 hours (need to join customer sync). Priya will escalate to me if anything P1.

priya: ack secondary. i'll watch support and be ready to escalate.

nate: retro invite sent for 11:00 UTC tomorrow; attendees: infra, eng-runtime, platform, product. agenda in ticket RED-INC-2050.

ryan: planning notes before i hand off later:
- verify deploy-bot reversion timer didn't accidentally revert required pinning
- confirm cronjob fix merged and deployed
- ensure HPA change PR references RED-OPS-500

maya: TL;DR handoff: primary -> ryan, secondary -> priya. Post-handoff owners: nate (postmortem), alex (infra ticket), alex+eng-runtime (HPA PR), priya (customer comms).

deploy-bot: Reminder: any rollback/pinning has a 30m revoke window; re-evaluate after postmortem.

paging-bot: handoff notice sent to rotation: ryan is primary at 2062234568.

ryan: Handoff acknowledged. I'll take first 90 minutes of monitoring.

priya: acknowledged secondary. Will post any customer flags to #support.

(End of thread)
